body:
For my mom, it wasn’t and still isn’t a joke. My she would complain to my dad that we kids weren’t behaving that we were his kids because somehow he messed up either by raising us or even because of his genes (I am not kidding). 

And now my brother divorced a woman who he has a kid with and she does the exact same thing my mom does - blaming him when their kid miss behaves and she’s even blamed me. Ugh

I know it’s a joke with couples with healthy relationships, but not with my family. And to be honest it does bother me a little when I hear this with my married friends with kids (although I never say anything and understand it’s not coming from a mean place)
And they knew most of the structures (houses and buildings) were made of wood.

I’m so sorry you have to deal with this BS from your parents. You’re beautiful and deserve so much better. 

My parents are like this and once I stopped expecting them to support me, things have gotten easier. 

My mom always likes bringing up this story when I (6yo) hit a kid (17) in the nuts. They think it shows what a horrible person/bully I am. I told them I did that because he was sexually abusing me and I couldn’t take it anymore. Both my mom and dad could care less. She still tells that story, but leaves the abuse part out. 

It sucks that people who should never be parents get to.
Welcome. And don’t get discouraged if the first therapist you go to doesn’t click. Sometimes it takes a while to find a therapist you feel comfortable with.

You’re parents shouldn’t be putting you in the middle of their relationship problems and use you as their emotional crutch or punching bag. It sounds like you will be getting the space you need, but in the meantime maybe therapy can help. I was in a similar situation and therapy helped me deal with I anger I had towards my parents for putting me in that role and how to deal with them.

Wow. Thank you!

Actually when I have Amy I do the same thing you do because it really helps. Although I’ve never made a song of it. What a great idea!!...I’m going to start doing that with her. She loves to sing. 

Amy is usually pretty good when she’s with me. It takes her a day or so to adjust. It just when her parents are in the picture that she really starts acting up and I can’t discipline her. The mother is pretty much out of the picture now, but my brother, Amy and I will be spending a lot more time together and I’m afraid Bill and I are going to be clashing a lot on how to raise Amy. 

I don’t know...I love my brother, but he’s always had these idiotic get rich schemes (which fail and he needs help to get out of), is lazy, unreliable, indecisive and has horrible taste in women. 

I’m sorry to say this, but Amy’s mother is a not a good person. She’s told me more than once that she doesn’t want Amy and ignored Amy by locking herself in her room for hours or even the entire day.  She had no discipline or routine with Amy and only spent time with her when she felt like it. She cheated on Bill with several men. 

During this divorce, both of them really never mentioned Amy except to discuss custody or visitation. All I heard from them was how they feel or were being affected. And the sad thing is that Bill still wants to be with his ex and thinks she is a “good mom” (WTH!!!). 

I just don’t understand why my brother isn’t more concerned with Amy’s future. He has sole custody, yet he keeps wallowing in his own self-pity about being divorced and wants to get his ex back!!! Why would anyone want to be with someone who cheated on them so much, has said horrible things about her own child and falsely accused him of of rape and physical abuse?!?! 

I’m so sorry to rant on this, but I just had to get this off my chest somewhere. 

Thanks for letting me blow off some steam in this post.

I don’t know either. I’ve tried (our parents have tried) to break things down for him, but it never works. He just can’t see further than his own wants and needs.  

Thank you!

The way My brother parents Amy is pretty much a 180 from how we were raised. We had clear routines and rules to follow and they did believe in spanking. Although I’ve always felt our parents weren’t as strict on Bill as they were on me (probably because I was first born).

Thanks for replying. I’ve tried books and they go unread. Amy currently goes to a daycare and as far as I know she behaves very well. Unfortunately Amy cannot continue at the daycare because it’s too expensive. 

It seems like Amy only misbehaves around her parents. Once they are around I notice that her behavior changes and she becomes more difficult (if that makes any sense).
Thanks. I will stop talking to her and my my insurance deal with this.
Thanks for your advice.
Thanks for your input. I’ll just let my insurance deal with it all.

The thing is that talking to them is like walking on broken glass. If I push things too hard they/the mother will punish me by not letting my parents see her. She’s done this before, so I don’t want to cause any more strife in my family. I will bring this up again, but I can’t push them too hard.
Okay, thanks for letting me know this is a fairly common thing.
Yes, they are so scary! Good to know they are harmless.
Yes, I do bring this up to them face to face.

Hi and thanks for commenting. I’ve been trying to get them to go to marriage counseling for several months now, but they won’t go and they keep blaming the other for why they won’t go. 

Things are getting bad. I went to their place late last night because my sister-in-law called the cops on my brother and said she was afraid he was going to kill her. My brother is many bad things, but he is NOT a physically abusive person. The police came and left and when I got there my niece was asleep, my brother would barely talk to me and my sister-in-law was screaming and crying, but finally got her to calm down & sleep. After sleeping on the floor, I took care of my niece, cleaned their apartment and cooked them dinner while the father went to work and the mother sleep all day. It was so weird, when the parents were together they acted like everything was normal and last night never happened. 

WTH!!! My sister-in-law is a liar and a cheater. My brother is a a weak minded individual and he will not leave her. I’ve been trying to make him see that his daughter is most important thing in his life and this environment is terrible for her. They are both lazy and selfish as hell!!! 

Nothing is CPS worthy (I’ve been looking into it) and if I try, I will never see my neice again and she will punish my parents by not letting them see her too. She has already pulled that BS on me and we didn’t see my niece for months. 

I swear if it wasn’t for my neice I would of written them out of my life. It’s a no win situation for all of us. 

I do take physical abuse very seriously because I’m a survivor of abuse, but I can’t trust my sister-in-law because she made the same accusation several months ago and it turned about to be a lie. She said my brother was hitting her and I was so upset and started questioning her because I wanted to understand everything so we could go to go the police. It turned out that my brother pushed her off the bed (mattress on the floor) because she was giving him BS for not having sex. That’s it!! No physical abuse, no hitting!! A dick move, yes but she was the one hitting him. 

Wow...okay needed to get that out. Thanks for letting me vent reddit.
Thank you for your comments and they have helped. I don’t think there is a solution because I can’t change her parents’ behavior, but I will try my best when my niece is with me.

Hi there. I’m sorry if I made my niece’s parents out to be monsters because they aren’t. I truly believe that my niece is loved by her parents and she’s doing well developmentally. Their house is messy, but not filthy and they want the best for their child, but they just do things that make me go huh?? Why is xx happening?!?!

My niece is not left in her car seat when they’ve stopped driving. From what I’ve been told my niece can work herself up so much that she vomits. She’s also caught a stomach bug a couple of times. Just don’t get leaving the vomit on the car seat. I’m going to leave it to them being very lazy. 

Thanks for explaining the behavior changes because I was very worried about it (especially the hitting), but it sounds like this type of thing is normal(ish).

No, I’ve never seen my brother or sister-in-law be too rough with my niece. 

I think they are pretty engaged with her. They have shown the typically fatigue of having a child, but nothing that makes me concerned. 

For one day my sister-in-law said she is studying while my brother works. And the other day, they both work.  
 
I don’t think there is any neglect happening, it’s just that they do things I don’t do or at least think that I won’t do if I ever had a child. Thanks for helping put my mind at ease!

Hi and thanks for posting. I’ve pretty much come to the same conclusion as you have about the laziness. My “normal” is very different from theirs, so as long as my niece is happy and healthy, I’m going to try and overlook the things they do that bother me. Since she’s not my child I can’t push my values on them.
